scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx devvit upload
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "CLIENT,SERVER,DEVVIT" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:devvit:resilient"
scripts.dev:devvit:resilient: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'while true; do npx devvit playtest; code=$?; if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "[DEVVIT] playtest disconnected (exit $code), retrying in 2s..."; sleep 2; done'
scripts.launch: npm run deploy && npx devvit publish
